SongComments.SongComment: This song shows some very basic beatslicing techniques, using the Sample Offset Command (0SXX) in combination with retriggers (RX), note column delays, backwards triggers (B0), pitch slides (0UXX, 0DXX) and volume cuts (0CXX).
Also watch the sample in the Sample Editor while playing back the VariationX Patterns, to get an idea what happens with the original loop...
Click the "Help->List Pattern Effect Commands..." menu entry to get an overview of all available sample commands.
